Plugin.Name: NBD Export
Plugin.Overview: Export a disk or partition as a Network Block Device (NBD) and image remote nbd:// targets to qcow2/raw. Settings → Network Services → NBD (next to NFS/SMB). Needs qemu-nbd/qemu-img (usually with Unraid VMs). Read-only by default; prefer private/Thunderbolt binds. Min Unraid 6.12 product — not a kernel feature. Thunderbolt Net optional for underlay.
